summary: The 6-K filing reports Vermilion Energy Inc.'s routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.135 CAD per common share, payable September 29, 2026, to shareholders of record September 15, 2026. This is a standard dividend announcement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is described. The filing contains no deal terms or strategic action beyond the ordinary capital return to shareholders. What to watch: further regulatory filings for any material corporate developments.
